sources.title: Missaukee County ordinances index
sources.note: Still lists the 1968 zoning ordinance and 1974-75 amendments to the 1973 County Interim Zoning Ordinance; no repeal is listed. Status of the interim ordinance is unknown.

sources.title: Ordinance 75 Z-2: Fourth Amendment to the Missaukee County Interim Zoning Ordinance
sources.note: Amends the county interim zoning ordinance adopted Aug 20, 1973 (FR, FA, AG, R districts). Allows an RV or mobile home in R-1-B "during the course of construction of a dwelling". No township exclusions; current force unknown.

sources.title: Ordinance 75 Z-3: Fifth Amendment to the Missaukee County Interim Zoning Ordinance
sources.note: District rezonings in Aetna, Bloomfield, Butterfield, Caldwell, Clam Union, Lake, Richland and (West) Norwich townships, e.g. Agricultural to Forest Recreational. No camping text.

sources.title: Ordinance 93-2: Missaukee County Mobile Home Construction Ordinance
sources.note: County-wide HUD construction standard and county building inspection for mobile homes used as residences or rentals. Does not define or mention RVs, travel trailers, tents or camping.

sources.title: Ordinance 98-1: County Building Official designated to enforce the State Construction Code
sources.note: Quote: the County "assumes responsibility for the administration and enforcement of said Act throughout its corporate limits." Building permits for structures go through the county.

sources.title: District Health Department #10 Sanitary Code (rev. 2019)
sources.note: Covers Missaukee (Sec. 1.03). Sec. 2.06 defines dwelling to include "any house, building, structure, tent, water craft, shelter, trailer or vehicle" used permanently or transiently; Sec. 4.11 habitable buildings need approved water and sewage; privies must be watertight vault type, 100 ft from other buildings, 10 ft from lot lines, with a permit. No camping-specific rule found; Ch. 5 end and Ch. 6-10 not yet read verbatim.

sources.title: Caldwell Township Ordinance No. 7: Mobile Home Construction
sources.note: Undated handwritten addition (OCR, uncertain): no trailer older than 1976 "shall be set or stored in Caldwell Township ... except those used explicitly for camping."

sources.title: Reeder Township Ordinance 2008-1: Blight Prevention
sources.note: "Junk" includes "trailers, mobile homes"; junk must be kept in a fully enclosed building. Amendment and the Anti-Noise/Public Nuisance ordinance are image-only scans and were not read.

sources.title: Richland Township Ordinance 2007-1: Blight Prevention
sources.note: Sec. 4(6) blight includes "any incomplete structure unless that structure is in the course of construction in accordance with a valid building permit"; vacant outbuildings must be kept secured.

sources.title: Missaukee County Building Department: written reply to camping and structures questions
sources.note: Emailed reply (county-wide, not township-specific): an owner may tent camp overnight on vacant private land with no county permit, minimum lot size or annual day limit, and may return over multiple years without building a house; a seasonal platform yurt is OK; any structure 200 sq ft or larger needs a county building permit, and electrical, mechanical or plumbing work needs its own permits; toilet and wastewater questions go to the health department; not aware of separate camping ordinances but advised checking township rules and deed restrictions.

sources.title: LeRoy Township Zoning Ordinance (2005)
sources.note: §10.1201: "Tents, and/or recreational vehicles and/or automobile trailers shall not be used for dwelling purposes within the township limits; provided, however, that recreational vehicles or automobile trailers may be used for temporary dwellings for a total period of not more than 90 days in any one year when located upon premises having running water and sewage facilities". §10.1407: "No accessory building or use shall be used or engaged in prior to the establishment of the principal building or use upon the premises except as a construction facility for said principal building." Township lists this as its current ordinance (with a 2021 amendment on C-1 uses).

sources.title: Frederic Township Zoning Ordinance (effective 2019-09-19, amended 2026)
sources.note: §3.14: "Camping in recreational units on private property shall be allowed in all districts except industrial and commercial. A. Two (2) recreational units are allowed on all lots for an unlimited period of time. More than two (2) recreational units on one (1) lot at one time shall be allowed for no more than thirty (30) consecutive days. A zoning permit is required ... B. Recreational units shall be allowed to be placed on a lot without a primary building." Units must be "moveable and road legal"; wastewater per District Health Department; "not to be used as permanent dwelling units." "Recreational unit" means trailers, RVs, campers; tents are listed under "Recreational Equipment", not recreational units. §3.13.H.2: outside R-1, "an accessory building shall be allowed without a principal building." §3.13: "All accessory buildings require zoning permits." PDF last modified 2026-02-18.

sources.title: Frederic Township Ordinance #2012-5 (Camping with a Recreational Unit)
sources.note: Scanned zoning amendment, adopted 2012-08-14, effective 2012-08-31: "Camping on private property shall be allowed in all districts except industrial and commercial." Carried forward and expanded as §3.14 of the 2019 zoning ordinance.

sources.title: Wexford Joint Planning Commission home page
sources.note: Serves Antioch, Boon, Cherry Grove, Hanover, Liberty, Selma, Slagle, South Branch, Springville and Wexford townships. Under "Zoning for other areas of Wexford County": "(There is no zoning in Colfax, Greenwood, or Henderson Townships)". The About page lists an amendment for "Greenwood Township's withdrawal from the WJPC"; the Zoning Ordinance page posts a "Zoning map detail for Liberty Township".

sources.title: Norwich Township Ordinance No. 2016-2 (camping and trailers)
sources.note: Scanned. Replaces §3.30E "in full". Camping trailers (travel trailers, motor homes, fifth-wheelers, campers) "shall not be used for camping ... unless" rules are met: no camping Jan 1–end of Feb without a written winter camping permit; "Each camping trailer must be removed from the lot or parcel on which it is used or stored for at least 60 continuous days per calendar year"; max four per parcel; must "register the camping trailer with the Township Zoning Administrator prior to any such camping"; sewage and water per health department and state law; no permanent residential use; "One storage shed with a ground dimension no larger than 8 feet by 10 feet is allowed for use accessory to a camping trailer ... shall not be on a permanent foundation"; one platform up to 6 x 8 ft; no in-ground septic, well or electric service with a camping trailer unless there is a lawful year-round dwelling, or the Zoning Administrator issues a zoning permit. Adopted at the 2016-11-12 board meeting; effective 7 days after publication. Does not address tents.

sources.title: Norwich Township Zoning Ordinance (adopted 2013-04-10, incl. 2017 revisions)
sources.note: Posted compilation still prints the pre-2016 §3.30E (temporary use permits "for only 60 contiguous days in total per calendar year", outhouses only if approved by the health department). §3.30C: "Recreational vehicles owned by residents or property owners within the Township shall not be connected to water or sanitary facilities, nor shall they be occupied." Article 11 W Wilderness: permitted uses are single family dwellings, public parks, agriculture, home occupations; private campgrounds by special use.

sources.title: Lake Township (Lake County) Zoning – Land Uses page
sources.note: Baldwin-area Lake Township in Lake County (not the Lake townships in Missaukee, Benzie, Roscommon or elsewhere). Posts "Zoning Ordinance 8-15-2026" and "Zoning Map 2026". Home page also lists a separate "DRAFT – Zoning Ordinance 6-10-2026".

sources.title: Lake Township (Lake County) Zoning Ordinance, version 8-15-2026
sources.note: Definition: "RECREATIONAL VEHICLE or RECREATIONAL EQUIPMENT" includes "motor homes, campers, camper trailers ... tents, and utility trailers". §3.24.B: "The recreational use of recreational vehicles is permitted when used exclusively for owner occupied ... recreational purposes"; placement needs setbacks and "potable water and sanitary waste disposal as approved by the Health Department"; "in districts zoned R-1 shall be allowed between April 1 and December 31 each year and in districts zoned R-2 and Ag/F placement/occupancy shall be allowed year round (even without a dwelling on site) so long as legal lot setbacks, potable water and proper septic system are available." §3.8.E(2): "Not more than one accessory storage building, not to exceed 100 square feet or more than 10 feet in height, may be erected on any vacant lot or parcel"; Land Use Permit and site plan required; no sleeping in it. §3.25: outhouses only in AG-F, minimum 2.5 acres and 200 ft width, 50 ft setbacks, health department permit. Original ordinance effective 1997-08-02.

sources.title: Grant & Sheridan Township (Clare County) Building Permit Checklist
sources.note: "Grant & Sheridan Township- Clare County, do not have zoning, but, do have set back requirements for any structures. (10' side; 20' easement)". Also references a mobile home ordinance (no mobile homes older than 1978) and "IT IS ILLEGAL TO OCCUPY/ USE THE STRUCTURE PRIOR TO OBTAINING AN OCCUPANCY PERMIT." Upload folder dated 2026/03.

sources.title: Isabella County Planning & Zoning: Administration & Enforcement
sources.note: "Isabella County currently has zoning jurisdiction in the following townships: Broomfield, Isabella, Sherman, Coldwater, Lincoln, Vernon, Denver, Nottawa, Gilmore, Rolland." "Zoning permits are typically required for any building or structure even if it is temporary or movable, on skids or a foundation." "Zoning permits are not required for residential accessory buildings or structures 200 square feet or less. However you are required to still maintain the district front, side and rear setback requirements."

sources.title: Isabella County Zoning Ordinance (effective 1989-02-15, amendments through 2026)
sources.note: §3.02.B.1.c (Agricultural Districts AG-1, AG-2, AG-3): "Accessory buildings and structures may be constructed on a lot without a principal building." §3.02.B.2.d (R-1, R-2, L-R): not without a principal building, except one accessory building up to 864 sq ft on a non-waterfront L-R lot. §3.28.C.3 (with a temporary permit): "An individual recreational vehicle or manufactured home may be approved in agricultural and L-R Districts as a temporary dwelling for a period up to 90 consecutive days per calendar year for recreational purposes only." Tents are defined but no private tent-camping rule was found. Cover: "THIS DOCUMENT CONTAINS ALL AMENDMENTS TO ORDINANCE THROUGH 2026".

sources.title: Ogemaw County Planning and Zoning: General Information
sources.note: "The Ogemaw County Zoning Ordinance is administered throughout the County, except within the borders of the City of West Branch (989-345-0500), West Branch Township (989-889-6291), and Edwards Township (989-305-2057)."

sources.title: Edwards Township Zoning Ordinance (adopted 1994, amendments through 2009; archive copy)
sources.note: Third-party archive copy (OCR scan retrieved 2023-11-07); no township website found. §2.12.A.5: "No accessory building shall be erected or placed on a lot unless a main building has been erected, placed, or established on the same lot." §2.11.B: "No accessory use shall be established on any lot unless a principle use has been established on the same lot." §2.10 allows a temporary manufactured home only while building a permanent residence. No section on camping, tents or RV occupancy was found. May have been amended since 2009.

sources.title: West Branch Township Zoning Ordinance (effective 2005-12-16, revised 2017-01-17; archive copy)
sources.issuer: West Branch Township (copy hosted by energyzoning.org)
sources.note: Definition: "Camping is the temporary placement on a property of five or less tents, travel trailers, or recreational vehicles. More than five units shall constitute a Lodge." §5.5.1 lists "Camping" among Permitted Principal Uses in the Agricultural (AG) District. §4.18.B.1.b: an RV "may be used as a temporary or seasonal residence within the AG, FR, CE Districts" but "shall not be occupied for a period in excess of thirty (30) days, unless permanent, on-site sanitary facilities, approved by the Ogemaw County Health Department are installed", then April 1 to November 30. §5.6.5 (FR): "A pole building or other storage building may be constructed without a principal structure provided setbacks are followed". The township URL printed on the cover (westbranchtownship.org) no longer belongs to the township.

sources.title: Gladwin County Zoning Ordinance (effective 2008-02-01, revisions to 2018-11-09)
sources.section: Definitions (Accessory Building, Temporary Dwelling, Recreational Equipment); §4.2.f; Table 2 (R-F uses)
sources.note: §4.2.f: "Recreational vehicles may be used as dwellings if they are placed on property owned by the resident of the RV and if they are not kept on the property more than six (6) months each calendar year. ... During the period when the RV is placed on the owner's property, it must be hooked to (an approved) well and septic or sewer system located on the same property". Definition: "TEMPORARY DWELLING: Includes, but is not limited to travel trailer, pop-up campers, modified trailers and tents". Accessory building is defined as "incidental to that of the main building, located on the same lot with the main building". Table 2 lists "Temporary Buildings or Trailers" as a use by right in R-F. No section on short-term tent camping was found. Linked as "Current Zoning Ordinance" from the Construction Codes page.

sources.title: Gladwin County Master Plan update (Planning Commission review draft, July 2026)
sources.note: "Gladwin County provides county-wide zoning services, except for Billings, Clement, Sage, Secord and Tobacco Townships, which independently administer their own zoning codes. The county-wide zoning ordinance became effective February 1, 2008." Draft document.

sources.title: Secord Township Ordinances & Zoning Regulations (searchable compilation)
sources.note: Cover: "UNOFFICIAL WEBSITE REFERENCE EDITION ... not a certified or signed copy." Zoning ordinance revised 11-15-17 (effective 11-30-17), with 2023 amendments. §3.16.A.1: "Overnight camping on private property shall be permitted in Districts R-1, R-2 and A-1 providing that the recreational vehicle or travel trailer shall carry a current state license plate". A.3: maximum two units. A.4: "Overnight camping on private property for 90 consecutive days during the months of May through November shall be allowed in districts R-1, R-2, and A-1 providing that the parcel owner receives a permit from the Zoning Administrator." A.4.c: "The travel trailer or recreational vehicle shall be connected to water and sewer services." Definition: Recreational Vehicle "includes but is not limited to motor homes, travel trailers, pop-up campers, modified trailers and tents."

sources.title: Tobacco Township Zoning Ordinance, Chapter 11 General Requirements (as amended 2010)
sources.note: §1103(11): "Recreational vehicles will not be used as a permanent dwelling. An RV occupied for a period of 3 months or more is defined as a permanent dwelling." §1103(12): "No portion of an accessory building in any Zoning District is to be used as a dwelling." Tents are not addressed. Document date is the amendment year only.

sources.title: Billings Township Zoning Ordinance (effective 2005-01-01, amended 2014-04-14; archive copy)
sources.note: Township website did not load; third-party archive copy. §11.04.A: in the A-1 District "Recreational vehicles may be parked, stored, or occupied as temporary living quarters on any lot", limited to the owner and guests; waste tanks emptied at a dump station; "All recreational vehicles, tents and similar camping gear and equipment shall be removed from the lot or stored within a completely enclosed accessory structure when not in use." §11.04.B (R-1 vacant lots): "Parking or occupancy of up to four (4) recreational vehicles or any camping on a vacant lot not exceeding a maximum of 72 hours per calendar year shall be allowed without zoning permit approval"; seasonal use April 15 to December 31 by zoning permit per RV; off-season 14-day permits; one storage accessory structure may stay. §6.101.A.1: "An accessory structure may be constructed or established on a parcel before or at the same time a principal building or use is being constructed". §6.207: "Outhouses, privies, and pit toilets shall be prohibited in any residential zoning district".

sources.title: Gladwin County Cities & Townships; Township and City Officials List (2026-09-28)
sources.note: Lists all 15 townships with hall addresses, meeting times and websites; the linked officials list gives clerks. Contacts saved privately, not here.

sources.title: Arenac County Master Plan (2021)
sources.note: "each municipality in Arenac County has adopted their own zoning regulations"; "Arenac County does not administer zoning".

sources.title: Arenac County Building Department jurisdiction list and inspectors/zoning officials list
sources.note: County issues building permits for Clayton, Mason, Moffatt, Sims, Standish, Turner and Whitney townships; "We do NOT issue for the City of Standish, or the following Townships: Adams, Deep River, Arenac, AuGres and Lincoln." Steps to build any structure start with "Local zoning". Well and septic permits: Central Michigan District Health Department.

sources.title: Moffatt Township Zoning Ordinance (2024-10-24)
sources.note: §4.18: "Trailers, campers, and other recreational vehicles may be placed and occupied as temporary living quarters on a vacant lot" subject to: A. a Zoning Administrator permit within 30 days of placing the unit; B. "No more than one (1) trailer, camper, or other recreational vehicle may be placed on a vacant lot for temporary dwelling purposed by the property owner" (guests up to two weeks); C. "shall be vacated and removed from the property on which it was placed for at least ninety (90) consecutive days during each calendar year"; E. Health Department rules. The same section also says it "shall not be construed to permit the temporary placement and occupancy of mobile homes, campers, trailers or other recreational vehicles on vacant lots outside of mobile home parks unless all other provisions of this Ordinance that apply to the use and occupancy of single-family dwellings have been met." §5.5.5 (Forested) and §5.6.5 (AG/RR): "A pole building or other storage building may be constructed without a principal structure provided setbacks are followed".

sources.title: Whitney Township Zoning Ordinance No. 2004-07 (as amended by No. 2025-02)
sources.note: §6.10.A: "Tents, travel trailers and other similar recreational vehicles shall not be used for dwelling purposes in residentially zoned districts", except (1) a travel trailer for up to a year while a home is built with a building permit and running water and sewage, and (2) "A tent or recreational vehicle may be used for temporary sleeping quarters for guests for a period not to exceed thirty days in any one calendar year. A permanent dwelling with proper running water and sewage facilities must be established where such temporary sleeping quarters is located." §6.09.A: "The use of privies and other outside toilet facilities is prohibited." Accessory B.2: in R-1 "no accessory building or use shall be used or engaged in prior to the establishment of the principal dwelling". Document date: amendment year only.

sources.title: Standish Township Zoning Ordinance 2014-11-01 (May 2022 compilation) and Ordinance 25-01
sources.note: §2.24 defines a recreational vehicle as "a motor home, travel trailer, truck camper, or camping trailer". "If a recreational vehicle is placed and occupied as temporary living quarters, for a period of more than seven (7) days on a parcel of land ... a permit for placement ... must be obtained ... within seven (7) days of placing the vehicle on the property. The permit shall be valid for one six (6) month period per year." Units must follow Health Department rules. Ordinance 25-01 (2025-10-14) only changes building-department references. The township also has a "Camping Permits" page whose text could not be read.

sources.title: Clayton Township Zoning Ordinance (amendments through 2015; archive copy)
sources.note: The township posts its ordinance at claytontownship.com as an image-only PDF; this text copy was used. §4.09.C "Hunting and camping. Trailers, campers, and other recreational vehicles placed on vacant lots shall comply with all applicable setbacks and other regulations. All recreational vehicles placed and occupied under the provisions of this Section shall comply with all Health Department regulations ... shall be legally operable". §4.09.B: six-month RV permit while building a home. No day limit or tent rule found.

sources.title: Turner Township Zoning Ordinance (March 2022; archive copy)
sources.note: Definition: "Camping is the temporary placement on a property of tents, travel trailers, or recreational vehicles." §5.5.1 (Agricultural / Rural Residential District, AR) Permitted Principal Uses: "H. Camping." No day limit found. Copy is stamped Aug. 29, 2023.

sources.title: Au Gres Township Zoning Ordinance (Dec 11, 2018, "Revised/Updated May 2024")
sources.note: The download link is labelled "2024 draft"; the cover says "Revised/Updated May 2024". §4.6.b (Lakeshore Residential only): guest RV up to 30 days a year; "Tent camping is limited to a visit of seven (7) days in any one year in LR". FR and AR: "A pole building, or other storage building may be constructed without a principal structure". Camping in FR and AR is not addressed.

sources.title: Lincoln Township (Arenac) Zoning Ordinance (adopted 2001-12-13)
sources.note: Read for camping, tents, RV occupancy and accessory buildings. No camping or RV-on-vacant-land section found; only a temporary dwelling during construction.

sources.title: Clare County Township Contact Information (2026-01-15)
sources.note: Zoned = Yes: Arthur, Freeman, Frost, Hamilton, Hatton, Hayes, Lincoln, Summerfield, Surrey, Winterfield. Zoned = No: Franklin, Garfield, Grant, Greenwood, Redding, Sheridan. Clare County has no county zoning ordinance listed. Contacts saved privately.

sources.title: Hayes Township Zoning Ordinance (2019, amended 2024-04-18) and Ordinance 25-01
sources.note: §1421: "Travel trailers, motor homes and other similar recreational vehicles designed with sleeping accommodations shall not be occupied for transient purposes for more than fourteen (14) days without a permit. A permit may be obtained from the Zoning Administrator for up to ninety (90) days with proof of electrical service and District Health Department approved water and sanitary facilities. ... shall not exceed ninety (90) days in any calendar year". §1422: "Outhouses, privies and pit toilets are prohibited in all zoning districts. Port a johns may be used with proof of being professionally maintained/serviced every thirty (30) days." The RV definition names tent trailers but not ground tents. Ordinance 25-01 (2025-07-22) allows shipping containers as accessory buildings.

sources.title: Winterfield Township Zoning Ordinance No. 03-03 (amended September 2023)
sources.note: §1320.1.d allows a trailer or temporary dwelling "On one's own land" if: "not more than one trailer or temporary dwelling on a parcel"; "The parcel on which the trailer is located contains no other structure or use"; it meets district area and setbacks; "The trailer is not connected to any water supply, electrical supply, septic tank, or other permanent sanitary facility"; "The trailer is serviced by an adequate temporary sanitary system such as holding tanks or porta-potties"; it is licensed; and "Its use is restricted to temporary recreation on a non-commercial/ no rental basis." §1320.3: if electric service is provided the trailer is treated as a permanent dwelling. No day limit stated. Tents are listed among items that "shall not be used as accessory buildings".

sources.title: Lincoln Township (Clare) Zoning Ordinance No. 44 (effective 2017-09-01, amended through 2022)
sources.note: §20.8: "The use of a recreational vehicle as a temporary dwelling on a vacant lot ... is prohibited except as approved by the Zoning Administrator ... An annual zoning permit is required for the occupancy of such a recreational vehicle and temporary storage structures." RR, R-1, R-2 or R-2A districts only; max two RVs (second needs 1.5 acres); 100 ft from the front lot line; "No recreational vehicle shall be parked on a lot for any period of time between November 1 and May 1" (an older line says December 1); not more than 30 days in any 90 consecutive days (60 with approved septic and utility electric), except in R-2A. Tents are not addressed.

sources.title: Greenwood Township: Zoning and Building Permits
sources.note: "Greenwood Township does not have zoning." Building permits are handled by the county; wells and septic by the Central Michigan District Health Department.
